correctness.rationale: Equations from every basis product are necessary and sufficient. Square equations force all image columns diagonal; offdiagonals live only in indegree-zero sibling fibers and are skew/symmetric by characteristic. The diagonal recurrence gives one central scalar per resonant cycle in characteristic not two and free leaf diagonals only in characteristic two. Direct-sum bracket preservation and both dimension formulas follow; finite independent-system checks verify 1164 sampled configurations, not the general proof.

value.rationale: Classifies a canonical derivation Lie algebra, not just dimensions, uniformly for every finite endofunction and field. Distinguishes signed orthogonal factors from characteristic-two symmetric-commutator factors and separates cycle-controlled resonance from leaf-sibling combinatorics. Star versus chain maps with identical cycle-only idempotent schemes have different derivation dimensions, supplying a substantive structural use of the invariant.
